import json,pathlib,subprocess
base=pathlib.Path('workspaces/repository-file-inventory-20261109')
progress=json.loads((base/'progress.json').read_text())
workflow='codespace-mcp-expression-inventory.yml'
for name in progress['order']:
    if name=='CommandLine':continue
    info=progress['per_repository'][name]
    assert info['status']=='verified'
    path=info['json_table_path']
    rows=json.loads(pathlib.Path(path).read_text())['rows']
    args=['gh','workflow','run',workflow,'--repo','BestNameYet/Terminals','--ref','main',
          '-f','source_repository=BestNameYet/'+name,
          '-f','source_ref='+info['head_sha'],
          '-f','file_list_path='+path]
    proc=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=45)
    print(json.dumps({'repo':name,'files':len(rows),'javascript':sum(row['language']=='javascript' for row in rows),
      'source_ref':info['head_sha'],'exit_code':proc.returncode,'dispatch_url':proc.stdout.strip(),'stderr':proc.stderr.strip()}),flush=True)
    if proc.returncode!=0:raise SystemExit(proc.returncode)
PY
